subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Starting next Monday, the library will open during lunch break.”?
options: If you have a book at home that you no longer read, you may bring it to the library and place it on the shelf.
A book can travel through a screen, but a library is also a place.
A girl with only four stamps described one book in detail and made everyone want to read it.
The library became quieter without Page, but everyone knew it now had a warmer home.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「If you have a book at home that you no longer read, you may bring it to the library and place it…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A book can travel through a screen, but a library is also a place.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A girl with only four stamps described one book in detail and made everyone want to read it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The library became quieter without Page, but everyone knew it now had a warmer home.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「If you have a book at home that you no longer read, you may bring it to the library and place it on the…」，答案為「If you have a book at home that you no longer read, you may bring it to the…」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「If you have a book at home that you no longer read, you may bring it to the…」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
